title: Single converted building package
description: Contract for one converted building package: identity, content and source provenance, frame data, symbols, parsed shape-style records with bitmap references, bitmap outputs with digests, and placement tiles recorded verbatim.

legacy_id.description: Building sprite stem, also the normalized img_name.

content_version.description: Content fingerprint of the normalized package inputs consumed.

content_ref.description: The single matched normalized building definition, recorded verbatim.

frame_width.description: Stage width in pixels from the SWF header.

frame_height.description: Stage height in pixels from the SWF header.

frame_rate.description: Frame rate in frames per second.

frame_count.description: Total frames declared in the header.

shapes.description: Parsed shape-style records with bounds, style types, bitmap references, and edge counts.

bitmaps.description: Bitmap outputs with digests, byte-copied from extraction outputs.

placement.description: Placement tiles recorded verbatim from the content definition.
